$notes.Origin.Unchanged: how the work origin is set at the start
$notes.Preparation.Label: what runs before the program on the job's timeline
$notes.Restart.Description: file name, then the tool operation it begins at
$notes.Segment.NoTool: an operation of the program without a tool number
$notes.Status.IsOn: name of a value: whether the laser or vacuum is switched on
$notes.Status.Value: a value of a status field the firmware does not explain, numbered

GoTo.NoPosition: The machine has not reported its position yet.
GoTo.NoWorkPosition: The machine has not reported the work position, so work coordinates can't be converted; use machine coordinates.

Mode.AntiStatic.Description: Static charge is removed while cutting.
Mode.AntiStatic.Name: Anti-static
Mode.BedClean.Description: The machine cleans the bed after the program.
Mode.BedClean.Name: Auto bed clean
Mode.Blow.Description: The spindle blower clears chips while cutting.
Mode.Blow.Name: Auto blow
Mode.ExternalOutput.Description: The external output follows the spindle.
Mode.ExternalOutput.Name: Auto external output
Mode.Vacuum.Description: The vacuum runs whenever the spindle does.
Mode.Vacuum.Name: Auto vacuum

Origin.XyzProbe: probed on the XYZ probe block ({0} mm high, tool {1} mm)

Resume.PositionUnknown: The job can't be resumed at line {0}: before it the program moved in machine coordinates (G53), so where the tool was is not known. Start the whole file or one of its operations instead.

Start.LevelingArea: Auto leveling needs a program that spans an area in X and Y.
Start.LevelingHeight: The leveling height must be between {0} and {1} mm.
Start.LevelingPoints: Auto leveling needs {0} to {1} points in X and Y.
Start.NoBedCorner: The machine's configuration has no bed corner (coordinate.anchor1_x/_y).
Start.NoHeadPosition: The machine has not reported where the head is.
Start.NothingToProbe: The program has no cutting moves, so there is no area to probe.

Timelapse.Preempted: Another viewer took over the machine's recording channel; open the recording again to continue.

Transfer.ListTimeout: The machine did not list {0} within {1:0} s.
Transfer.NoResponse: No response from the machine after {0} retries.
Transfer.StoppedAsking: The machine stopped asking for data ({0}).
Transfer.UploadCancelled: The machine cancelled the upload. It accepts files only while it is not moving.
Transfer.WrongPacket: The machine asked for packet {0} of {1}.
